title: Leading layout / New season
slide_intent: Separate attribution and release information from expressive title scale so viewers can read both quickly.
strategic_value: The small green 4 and date can identify Channel 4 even when oversized show lettering dominates.
demonstration: A cropped red-and-pink poster detail places the green 4 at upper left, The new season / 30 August beside it, and oversized pink title letters below.
practical_value: Keep essential release information legible when the main title is deliberately cropped.

content_islands.name: Identity and date
content_islands.spec: Align the small mark with the compact new-season date block.

content_islands.name: Oversized title
content_islands.spec: Let the large pink lettering extend beyond the lower and right edges.

reference_purposes.Application: The poster detail applies a leading identity and date above oversized show typography.
